title: Nanna QoL
body:
# Nanna QoL

A modpack made between friends to start a private server for seasonal fun.

The idea of the modpack is to have the resources to create farms easily with the mod of [Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica), that is the core of this modpack, we added some optimization mods to ensure that all the farms that you will create works correctly plus some visual mod like the [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons) to view all the farms together.

Right now there is only mods, but in the future the idea is upload all the schematic files related to the farms to make it more accesible to all.
